items.question: What number of recitations and oblation perfect this mantra?
premises: One should mutter the mantra ten-thousand times.
One should accomplish the mantra with oblation.
The accomplishment follows the prescribed recitation.
items.inference: Ten-thousand recitations followed by oblation accomplish the mantra.
uncertainties: The surface form dhaviṣā may reflect a variant spelling of haviṣā.
items.plain_english: One should recite this mantra ten thousand times and then accomplish it with an oblation.
